name: Tute
description: Tute is one of Spain's most popular card games, played with a 40-card Spanish deck. Named from Italian 'tutti'. Features A-3-K ranking, strict follow-suit/trump rules, and 'Cantes' (declaring K+Kt of same suit for bonus). Collecting all 4 Kings or 4 Knights = instant Tute win. 10 bonus for last trick.

history.origins: Tute originated in Italy, where it was known as tutti (the declaration for holding all four kings or four jacks). During the 19th century the game spread to Spain, reportedly brought back by Spanish troops returning from missions in Italy; Spanish speakers adapted the name to tute. It became one of the most popular card games in Spain and is also played in some Latin American countries; in Mexico it was known as tuti. The game is a point-trick game of the marriage type, related to Brisca and other Mediterranean ace-ten games.

setup.deck: 40 Spanish cards. Rank: A-3-K-Kt-J-7-6-5-4-2. Values: A=11, 3=10, K=4, Kt=3, J=2. Total 120 pts.
setup.dealing: 2p: 8 each +stock. 3p: 13 each. 4p: 10 each. Last card = trump.

rules.objective: Score 101+ points. Or declare Tute (4 Kings or 4 Knights).
rules.gameplay: Follow suit. Must play higher if possible. Must trump if void in suit. Cantes: K+Kt of trump = 40 pts. K+Kt of other suit = 20 pts. Cantes only after winning first trick. Last trick = 10 bonus. 7 of trumps can swap with face-up trump card.
keyRules: Must follow suit AND play higher
Tute: 4 Kings or 4 Knights = instant win

strategy.basic: Win tricks with Aces and 3s. Declare Cantes.
strategy.intermediate: Manage trump suit. Time Cante declarations.
strategy.advanced: Track all high cards. Control endgame for last-trick bonus.
